inner_split_source: revision_2026/03_corrected_protocol/corrected_split_assignment.csv using outer_role=outer_train and inner_role labels with purged_inner_boundary rows excluded from inner_train

preprocessing_method.feature_assembly: submitted build_ulsan_npz-style feature construction with dropna on required features and target
preprocessing_method.scaler: StandardScaler fit only on training partition for each fit

selection_rule: For each horizon and outer_fold, evaluate every candidate alpha by fitting scaler plus Ridge on purged inner_train rows and scoring MAE on inner_validation rows from corrected split assignment; choose the alpha with minimum inner_validation_MAE.
tie_break_rule: If multiple candidate alphas tie on inner_validation_MAE within absolute tolerance 1e-12, select the numerically smallest alpha before any fitting on outer_test rows.
